rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for courage or bravery.

example.english: It takes real bravery to face such a big difficulty.
example.traditional: 面對咁大嘅困難，真係要有勇氣。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 gam3 daai6 ge3 kwan3 naan4 zan1 hai6 jiu3 jau5 jung5 hei3

rows.note: Use this when bravery means having the nerve to face danger or take a risk.

example.english: It takes real bravery to jump into the sea to save someone.
example.traditional: 跳落海救人，真係要有膽量。
example.jyutping: tiu3 lok6 hoi2 gau3 jan4 zan1 hai6 jiu3 jau5 daam2 loeng6
